# Repository description (paste into GitHub "About" field)
# Max 350 characters.

A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.x that turns the world creation Seed field into a natural-language search bar. Type "village near warm ocean" or "mansion dark forest" — the mod runs a multi-threaded seed search and spawns you next to the requested feature. Bilingual (RU + EN), extensible dictionary, atomic progress counters.

# Suggested "About" tagline (long version, ~200 chars)

Type "village near warm ocean" in the Seed field. WyWF parses your request,
runs a multi-threaded seed search, and spawns you next to the feature you
asked for. Bilingual dictionary (RU + EN), extensible, no Yarn mappings.
Licensed under Apache 2.0.
